goal.name: Study Mabel’s moving banner
goal.text: A moon rests above a moth. Beneath them, a stitched door stands open.

goal.name: Reconstruct the living pattern
goal.hint: Read the banner from top to bottom.

goal.name: Read the old miners’ marks
goal.text: The oldest mark is a small bell, followed by a candle and then a star.

goal.name: Answer the ringing stones
goal.hint: The miners’ marks show the ringing order.

goal.name: Turn the three garden lanterns
goal.hint: Follow the order of healthy growth.

goal.name: Watch Mabel open her door
goal.text: The courtyard breathes. A little light travels from Mabel’s window to Tansy’s garden, and the brambles fold back into the earth.

goal.name: Read the scarecrow’s crooked rhyme
goal.text: Moon before crow, crow before thorn; knock on the door before supper is born.

goal.name: Ring the three field bells
goal.hint: The scarecrow’s rhyme names the order.

goal.name: Knock on Granny’s listening house
goal.text: The window opens. “Well,” says Granny Brambletooth, “you remembered to knock. That puts you ahead of most crows.”

walks.label: Granny’s actual cottage door approach through the authored maize paths

goal.name: Route the bridge lanterns
goal.hint: Turn the mirrors so the lantern beam travels from the entry arrow to the star. A straight mirror must join opposite sides; corner mirrors join two sides.

walks.label: the cave entrance from Opal’s quarry

goal.name: Read the forgotten supper menu
goal.text: A warm dish, a garden garnish and a bright lantern: three things the empty restaurant has been missing.

goal.name: Remember Cinder’s supper flavours
goal.hint: A warm pumpkin dish, a garden garnish and a gentle buttery finish. There was no chilli on the old menu.

goal.name: Set the opening stage cues
goal.hint: The audience needs light before the curtain rises, and the bow comes last.

goal.name: Choose the lantern-night programme
goal.hint: Welcome the neighbours before supper; stories lead to the show.

goal.name: Supply the Lantern Night supper
goal.text: Bring twelve unreserved pumpkins and four cooked portions for your neighbours.

walks.label: Light the village’s five remembered places

goal.name: Light the village’s five remembered places
goal.hint: Follow the road your story took.

route.name: Light the village’s five remembered places
route.hint: Follow the road your story took.

goal.name: Begin Lantern Night
goal.text: Every window is lit. Granny arrives carrying something that smells surprisingly like cake. Elowen closes the almanac, then opens a new page: Tomorrow.

scope: Exact unchanged offline HTML served from captured bytes on loopback. One software Chromium. A declared level6 farm with legacy Two Doorbells starts with a fresh expansion; its new Copse chapters use real gamepad walking, nearby world picks and live puzzle buttons. Later level changes and prerequisite branch fixtures are explicitly recorded. No new-chapter completion APIs or actor-position mutation. Only renderer/composer calls are held for deterministic logic bursts; normal photographs restore renderer, composer and real RAF village ticks. Mocked standard Gamepad API and viewport sizes do not certify physical PS5 Bluetooth, Fold or TV hardware, or device frame rate.
